Take Section 3013—cracking down on fentanyl imports? Good. Yet agencies like HHS waste millions on redundant grant programs while veterans drown in addiction.

The 2018 version allocated $4B for opioid efforts, but how much vanished into “administrative costs” instead of frontline treatment? Real progress means slashing red tape, not applauding half-measures.

Cut the bloat, redirect every dollar to actual recovery—not more paperwork for dying Americans.
